classes.name: Zgjedhjet për Kuvendin e Republikës së Kosovës
classes.name_en: Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo
classes.note: 120 deputies elected for four years from open lists in a single nationwide district, in proportion to valid votes; 20 seats are guaranteed to non-majority communities (10 Serb, 10 for the Roma, Ashkali, Egyptian, Bosniak, Turkish, and Gorani communities), filled from the same ballot (Constitution art. 64). Elections are held at the latest 30 days before the term ends, or within 45 days of a dissolution (art. 66). The 2010 election had revotes in several municipalities in January 2011. Before the Constitution the Assembly was elected under the UNMIK Constitutional Framework (class kuvendi_kk).

classes.name: Zgjedhjet për Kuvendin e Kosovës sipas Kornizës Kushtetuese
classes.name_en: Assembly of Kosovo under the UNMIK Constitutional Framework (2001-2008)
classes.locator: https://gzk.rks-gov.net/ActDetail.aspx?ActID=3702 (art. 162: the Constitution replaces the Constitutional Framework on 15 June 2008)
classes.note: Under UNMIK Regulation 2001/9 (Constitutional Framework for Provisional Self-Government), 120 members were elected for three years in a single nationwide district: 100 by proportional representation and 20 reserved for non-majority communities (10 Serb, 10 others). Lists were closed in 2001 and 2004 and open in 2007. The OSCE Mission ran the 2001 and 2004 elections through the Central Election Commission; the Commission ran the 2007 election jointly with the local elections.

classes.name: Zgjedhja e Presidentit të Republikës së Kosovës nga Kuvendi
classes.name_en: President of the Republic, elected by the Assembly
classes.note: The Assembly elects the President by secret ballot for five years, renewable once: two-thirds of all deputies in the first two rounds, otherwise a third round between the two leaders by a majority of all deputies; failure within 60 days dissolves the Assembly (arts. 82, 86, 87). The election of 22 February 2011 was annulled by the Constitutional Court on 28 March 2011.

classes.name: Zgjedhja e Presidentit të Kosovës sipas Kornizës Kushtetuese
classes.name_en: President of Kosovo under the Constitutional Framework, elected by the Assembly (2002-2008)
classes.note: Under Regulation 2001/9 the Assembly elected the President for three years, by two-thirds in the first two rounds and a simple majority in the third. Rugova was elected on 4 March 2002 after failed rounds from December 2001, and again after the 2004 election; Sejdiu succeeded him on his death and was re-elected after the 2007 election.

dates.note: Rugova re-elected after the 2004 Assembly election; the day is not confirmed from an official record.

classes.name: Referendumi
classes.note: The Assembly announces a referendum in accordance with the law (art. 65(3)) and the Central Election Commission conducts it and declares its result (art. 139(1)); laws of vital interest cannot be put to a referendum (art. 81(2)). None has been held under the Constitution.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet për Kuvendet e Komunave
classes.note: Each municipality is one district; seats go to entities by the divisors 1, 3, 5, 7 (Sainte-Laguë) and to candidates by preference votes with a 30% gender quota (Law 03/L-072 arts. 7-8). Assembly size runs from 15 to 51 by population (Law 03/L-040 art. 36). Under UNMIK the 30 municipalities of Regulation 2000/43 elected closed-list assemblies in 2000 and 2002; the 2007 elections were the last under UNMIK, and the 38 municipalities of Law 03/L-041 first voted in 2009 (North Mitrovica in 2013).

classes.name: Zgjedhjet për Kryetarë të Komunave
classes.note: Each municipality elects its mayor directly for four years; a candidate with more than half of the valid votes wins, otherwise the two leaders meet in a runoff (Law 03/L-072 art. 9). A mayor whose term ends early is replaced by an extraordinary election for the rest of the term (art. 11); the four northern municipalities held them in 2019 and 2023. Mayors were first elected directly in 2007; before that the municipal assembly chose its president.

classes.name: Votimi për largimin e kryetarit të komunës
classes.note: A petition signed by 20% of registered voters puts the mayor's removal to a vote, which succeeds only if a majority of all registered voters vote for it; a new mayoral election follows (Law 03/L-040 art. 72). The Commission ran the only such votes on 21 April 2024 in North Mitrovica, Leposaviq, Zubin Potok, and Zveçan; turnout was far below the threshold and all four mayors stayed.

classes.name: Referendumi komunal
classes.note: Ten percent of registered voters may, within 30 days, ask that a regulation the municipal assembly adopted be put to a referendum (Law 03/L-040 art. 71). No such referendum is known to have been held.

classes.name: Këshillat e fshatrave dhe të lagjeve
classes.disposition_reason: Set up by each municipality's statute under Law 03/L-040 art. 34 and chosen at residents' meetings; the Central Election Commission does not run them and no results are published.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet e brendshme të partive
classes.disposition_reason: Parties choose their leaders and candidates under their own statutes; the state neither runs nor publishes these votes, and no law provides for state-run primaries.

classes.name: Zgjedhja e anëtarëve të Këshillit Gjyqësor dhe të Këshillit Prokurorial
classes.name_en: Members of the Judicial and Prosecutorial Councils
classes.disposition_reason: Judges and prosecutors elect some council members among themselves and the Assembly elects others; these are internal or indirect votes, not public elections. Judges are appointed, never elected.

classes.name: Kuvendi i Krahinës Socialiste Autonome të Kosovës
classes.name_en: Assembly of the Socialist Autonomous Province of Kosovo (1945-1990)
classes.disposition_reason: A provincial assembly of Serbia within Yugoslavia, chosen through the Yugoslav delegate system until 1990; it belongs under a Yugoslav or Serbian polity if the archive adds one, and no official vote counts survive.

classes.name: Referendumi dhe zgjedhjet e institucioneve paralele të Republikës së Kosovës
classes.name_en: Referendum and elections of the parallel Republic of Kosova (1991-1998)
classes.disposition_reason: The 1991 independence referendum and the 1992 and 1998 parliamentary and presidential votes were run by unrecognized parallel institutions outside any state election administration; the Central Election Commission holds no results for them.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet e organizuara nga Serbia në Kosovë
classes.locator: https://gzk.rks-gov.net/ActDetail.aspx?ActID=3702 (art. 139: the Central Election Commission conducts all elections)
classes.disposition_reason: Serbia's parliamentary, presidential, and (until 2013) local elections held among Kosovo Serbs belong to Serbia's census; Kosovo's authorities do not recognize them and publish no results.
